title: CantonReceipt
description: Participant-operator-signed off-chain settlement artefact. The bytes signed by the participant-operator Ed25519 key are produced by pkg/receipt.CantonReceipt.Canonical() and exclude `signature` and `receiptPayloadHash`. `domain` is included as an explicit prefix in the canonical bytes to provide cross-protocol domain separation.

domain.description: Domain-separation tag included as an explicit prefix in the canonical bytes. v1 value: "goat-canton-receipt:v1".

ledgerId.description: Canton ledger id of the participant that confirmed the transaction.

transactionId.description: Canton transaction id for the confirmed `Pay` exercise.

contractId.description: Contract id of the resulting merchant `Holding`.

paymentRequestContractId.description: Contract id of the `PaymentRequest` that was exercised.

participantPartyId.description: Canton party id of the participant operator that signed the receipt.

merchant.description: Canton party id of the payee.

payer.description: Canton party id of the payer.

amount.description: Decimal-as-string; canonical form (no leading +, no leading zeros except 0.x, no scientific notation, integer-side <= 28 digits, fractional-side <= 10 digits).

trustedIssuer.description: Canton party id of the trusted asset issuer for `currency`. Re-asserted by the merchant verifier against its `TRUSTED_ISSUER_MAP[currency]`.

resource.description: Merchant resource path that this receipt authorises.

merchantRequestId.description: Mirrors the challenge nonce the merchant issued in its 402 envelope. Binds the receipt to a specific 402 session.

expiresAtHttp.description: HTTP-form expiry as Unix epoch milliseconds. This is the value covered by the payer's signature.

expiresAtDaml.description: Daml-form expiry (HTTP-form + LEDGER_SKEW_SAFETY) as Unix epoch milliseconds. Surfaced for auditor reconciliation; not in the payer's signed preimage.

signature.description: Base64-encoded raw signature bytes. PureEdDSA over `Canonical()` output (which excludes this field and `receiptPayloadHash`).

receiptPayloadHash.description: Base64-encoded sha256 of the canonical receipt bytes (display-only digest; NOT the input to ed25519.Sign).

completedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds; when the participant observed mediator confirmation for the underlying transaction.
